# Assure Plumbing & Septic

> Assure Plumbing & Septic is a licensed plumbing and septic contractor based in Fredericksburg, Virginia. It serves homeowners along the I-95 corridor between Stafford and Richmond, with plumbing repair, repiping, leak repair, sump pumps, water heaters, water treatment, well pumps, gas lines, septic repair, alternative septic systems and septic pumping.

Also known as: Assure Plumbing and Septic.

## Key facts

- Phone: (540) 645-1351
- Email: assureplumbingseptic@gmail.com
- Office: 1320 Central Park Blvd Ste 200, Fredericksburg, VA 22401
- Hours: Tuesday to Friday, 8:00 AM to 5:00 PM
- Contact and quotes: https://www.assureplumbingva.com/contact
- Google rating: 5.0 from 300+ Google reviews
- Facebook: https://www.facebook.com/assureplumbingseptic
- Licenses, all issued by the Virginia Department of Professional and Occupational Regulation (DPOR):
  - Class A Contractor: 2705180708
  - Plumbing / Gas Fitting: 2710068920
  - Onsite Sewage System Installer (septic): 1942001502
- Primary service area: Fredericksburg, Stafford County and Spotsylvania County. Plumbing extends north to Stafford, west to Culpeper, east to Colonial Beach and south to Richmond.
- Septic pump-outs are offered only in Fredericksburg, Spotsylvania County and Stafford County. Other septic work stays close to those same areas.
- Pricing: a detailed estimate with a labor and parts breakdown is given after inspection, with no hidden fees. Problems are diagnosed before quoting.
- Maintenance plans and alternative septic maintenance contracts are available.

## Services

- [Plumbing](https://www.assureplumbingva.com/service/plumbing): Repairs, installations and maintenance, including faucets, garbage disposers, clogged drains, noisy pipes and commercial plumbing.
- [Leak repairs](https://www.assureplumbingva.com/service/leak-repairs): Leaking and burst pipes, faucet leaks, hidden water leaks and main water line leaks.
- [Water heaters](https://www.assureplumbingva.com/service/water-heater): Installation, repair and replacement of tank, gas and tankless water heaters, plus anode rods and pressure relief valves.
- [Repiping](https://www.assureplumbingva.com/service/repiping): Whole-home and partial repipes, pipe replacement and trenchless water line repair.
- [Sump pumps](https://www.assureplumbingva.com/service/sump-pumps): Sump pump installation, repair and maintenance, battery backups, and sewer ejector and grinder pumps.
- [Water treatment](https://www.assureplumbingva.com/service/water-treatment): Water testing, whole-home filtration, reverse osmosis, UV purification and water softeners.
- [Well pumps](https://www.assureplumbingva.com/service/well-pumps): Well pump repair, replacement and pulling, well pressure tanks, and well water treatment and inspections.
- [Septic pumping](https://www.assureplumbingva.com/service/septic-pumping): Septic tank pumping, offered only in Fredericksburg, Spotsylvania County and Stafford County.
- [Septic repair](https://www.assureplumbingva.com/service/septic-repair): Septic system repair, pumps, floats, control panels, septic installs, and sewer line repair and replacement.
- [Alternative septic](https://www.assureplumbingva.com/service/alternative-septic): Licensed service, repair and annual Virginia Department of Health (VDH) inspections for alternative septic systems, including Puraflo, Advantex, Norweco and Orenco.
- [Other services](https://www.assureplumbingva.com/service/other): Plumbing and septic work not listed above.
